احتبسنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَبَسْنَا (iḥtabasnā) /iħ.ta.bas.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
# اُحْتُبِسْنَا (uḥtubisnā) /uħ.tu.bis.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَبَسَ (iḥtabasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
